title: Merge k Sorted Lists
description: You are given an array of `k` linked-lists `lists`, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
input_format:
The first line contains `K`, the number of sorted lists.
The next `K` lines each start with `L_i` (length of the list) followed by `L_i` space-separated sorted integers.
output_format: Print all merged elements space-separated in ascending order.

hints.text: Use a Min-Heap (Priority Queue) to track the smallest current element among all k lists in O(log k) time.
Alternatively, use Divide and Conquer: pair up k lists and merge each pair in O(N log k) total time.
